source: Mapzen/Tilezen Terrain Tiles on AWS; USGS GMTED2010/SRTM and NOAA ETOPO1
processing: Terrain-anchored pictorial relief for the Iron Gates region. Symbols use spaced elevation maxima above 900 m inside the display window [20, 42.5, 25.5, 46.5], not a mountain-range boundary. North-up silhouette clipping prevents overlapping faces and ink. Display only; never used for grading.
